title: BA1/304/2010 of SARTAZ Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Criminal First Bail Application No.304 of 2010
Order on the Bail application of accused
CRIMINAL SIDE
Sartaz S/o Mastan
ÖÖÖ.Applicant (In Jail)
Versus
State of Uttarakhand ------- Opposite party
________________________________________________________
Arising out of FIR No.65 of 2009,
U/s 18/20 NDPS Act, P.S. Kathgodam, Distt. Nainital
Dated: March 12, 2010
Hon'ble Dharam Veer, J.
 Heard Sri S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for the
applicant and Sri M.A. Khan, learned Brief Holder for the
State.
 In brief the prosecution case is that on 16.11.2009,
about two kilograms of opium was said to be recovered
from the possession of the applicant/accused. Learned
counsel for the applicant submitted that the commercial
quantity of opium is 2.5 kilograms while the opium
recovered from the possession of the present applicant is
only 2 kilograms which is less than the commercial
quantity. Lastly, he is in jail since 16.11.2009 and he has
got no criminal history before this case.
 After considering all the facts and circumstances,
without expressing any opinion about the final merits of
the case, the Court is of the view that the present applicant
deserves bail at this stage.
 Let the applicant Sartaz be released on bail on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two sureties each
in the like amount to the satisfaction of Special Judge,
Narcotics Drugs & Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985,
Distt. Nainital.
 The bail application is allowed accordingly.
 (Dharam Veer, J.)
12.03.2010
Rajeev Dang
